Data.Description: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management System pack. Sample bundle built from PM-curated Excel of UiPath platform controls mapped to ISO 42001 clauses.

Controls.DisplayName: Agent Guardrail — Sensitive Data Exposure Protection
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable sensitive data exposure protection guardrails in UiPath agents as a control to mitigate identified impacts on individuals. This guardrail directly supports the AI system impact assessment process by operationalizing protections for personal and confidential data in AI interactions.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Centralized Guardrails

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable prompt injection prevention guardrails in UiPath agents as a risk treatment control identified through the AI system impact assessment. Prompt injection represents a foreseeable misuse of AI systems that can result in unauthorized actions or data exposure.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Centralized Guardrails

Controls.Description: The organization should enable EDR status visibility in UiPath Assistant as part of its documentation and monitoring of system and computing resources used by AI automation. Endpoint protection status is a relevant attribute of the computing resources on which AI automation executes, and its visibility supports the organization's AI system resource management processes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Feature Toggles

Clauses.ClauseName: Processes for responsible AI system design and development

Controls.Description: The organization shall enforce the use of the UiPath Object Repository for UI element management as part of its responsible AI design process, ensuring that selectors used in AI automation are centrally governed and maintainable.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Object Repository enforced

Controls.Description: The organization shall use UiPath Workflow Analyzer rule ST-USG-027 to mandate inclusion of required packages (e.g. logging, security) in all AI automation projects, ensuring that responsible design standards are consistently applied. To configure: enable ST-USG-027 at Error and list the mandatory packages in RequiredPackages.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > ST-USG-027

Controls.Description: The organization shall define permitted compatibility frameworks (Windows, Cross-platform) in UiPath as part of the AI system requirements specification, ensuring consistent deployment targets and reducing support complexity. To configure: enable the toggle and select the permitted frameworks (Windows / Cross-platform).
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Allowed compatibility frameworks

Controls.Description: The organization shall define and document application-specific prompt additions used in UiPath ScreenPlay as part of the AI system requirements, ensuring custom prompts have been reviewed for prompt injection risks and unintended behavioral effects. To configure: enable the Applications custom prompts rule and add security-reviewed application-specific prompt text.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > UIAutomation > ScreenPlay > Applications custom prompts

Controls.Description: The organization shall define and document URL-specific prompt additions used in UiPath ScreenPlay as part of the AI system requirements, ensuring they have been reviewed for prompt injection risks and are constrained to the intended use of the AI system. To configure: enable the URLs custom prompts rule and add security-reviewed URL-specific prompt text.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > UIAutomation > ScreenPlay > URLs custom prompts

Controls.DisplayName: Test Manager — Enable Test Manager AI
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable AI-assisted test case generation in UiPath Test Manager as part of its AI system verification and validation processes, ensuring that AI-generated test cases are reviewed by qualified personnel before use.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Test Manager features

Controls.Description: The organization shall enforce Workflow Analyzer execution before publishing in UiPath, ensuring that automated quality and security checks are a mandatory step in the AI system verification process prior to deployment.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Enforce Analyzer before Publish

Controls.Description: The organization shall enforce Workflow Analyzer execution before running automations in UiPath, ensuring that AI system components meet defined quality criteria before execution in any environment.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Enforce Analyzer before Run

Controls.Description: The organization shall enforce Workflow Analyzer checks before source control commits in UiPath, integrating AI system validation into the development workflow and preventing known issues from entering the code repository.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Enforce Analyzer before Push/Check-In

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict the use of preview activity packages in production UiPath environments, as unvalidated packages do not meet the organization's AI system verification criteria and may introduce untested behaviors.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Allow preview packages in Activities Panel

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable and enforce UiPath Workflow Analyzer security rules (ST-SEC-*) at Error level, ensuring that automated static analysis detects hardcoded credentials, insecure string handling, and other security violations as part of the AI system verification process.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > ST-SEC*

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable UiPath Workflow Analyzer rule UI-SEC-010 to allow/forbid apps/URLs automation as part of the AI system verification process. To configure: enable UI-SEC-010 and populate whitelistApps, blacklistApps, whitelistUrls and blacklistUrls.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > UI-SEC-010

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable UiPath Workflow Analyzer rule UX-DBP-029 at Error level to detect plaintext password handling in AI automation code, enforcing SecureString usage as a mandatory verification criterion.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > UX-DBP-029

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable UiPath Workflow Analyzer rule UI-DBP-030 to flag the use of variables in selectors, which may introduce injection risks in AI-driven UI automation and must be reviewed as part of the verification process.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > UI-DBP-030

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict the use of preview activity packages in production UiPath environments, as unvalidated packages do not meet the organization's AI system verification criteria and may introduce untested behaviors.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Activities > Enable preview packages and activities

Controls.Description: The organization shall require source control check-in before publishing AI automation in UiPath, ensuring that all deployed AI system components are version-controlled and traceable as part of the deployment process.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design > Enforce Check-In before Publish

Controls.Description: The organization shall control project import capabilities in UiPath Studio Web, ensuring that imported automation projects are subject to review before deployment, consistent with the organization's AI system deployment requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Feature Toggles > Allow users to import projects

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict publishing outside personal workspaces in UiPath Studio Web to authorized personnel, ensuring that AI automation deployment is controlled and consistent with documented release criteria.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Feature Toggles > Allow users to publish outside Personal Workspace

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure dependency auto-update policies in UiPath Studio Web to require review before application, ensuring that updates to AI system component dependencies are controlled and do not introduce unvalidated changes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Activities > Enforce dependencies auto-update

Controls.Description: The organization shall enforce release notes for all UiPath automation publications, ensuring that changes to AI system components are documented and available to relevant stakeholders as part of the AI system technical documentation requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Design

Clauses.ClauseName: AI system recording of event logs

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure the UiPath AI Trust Layer trace data retention period to ensure that AI interaction records are preserved for a duration sufficient to support incident investigation, bias detection, and compliance audits, as defined in the AI management system documentation.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Feature Toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable input/output logging in the UiPath AI Trust Layer to create an auditable record of prompts submitted to and responses received from AI models. This log is a critical control for detecting prompt injection, investigating AI incidents, and demonstrating responsible AI use.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Feature Toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure screenshot saving for the UiPath Healing Agent with a defined retention policy, ensuring visual diagnostic records are available for AI incident investigation while minimizing unnecessary data capture.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Healing Agent

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure UiPath UIAutomation trace retention in accordance with its AI event log requirements, ensuring records are preserved for the duration needed to support monitoring, debugging, and compliance auditing.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > UIAutomation > Generic

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure UiPath ScreenPlay trace retention to ensure that AI-driven UI interaction records are available for the duration required by the AI management system's event log requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > UIAutomation > ScreenPlay

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict the ability for users to change logging levels in UiPath, ensuring that AI system event log verbosity remains consistent with the organization's monitoring and audit requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Feature Toggles

Clauses.ClauseName: Data for development and enhancement of AI system

Controls.DisplayName: Trace Management — Restrict Insights Trace Data
Controls.Description: The organization shall configure the level of AI trace detail forwarded to UiPath Insights in accordance with its data management processes, ensuring that sensitive prompt and response data is not exposed beyond the personnel authorized to access it.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Feature Toggles > Restrict Insights Trace data

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable the UiPath Studio Web user feedback mechanism to provide a channel for reporting concerns about AI system behavior, supporting the organization's obligation to maintain external reporting capabilities for AI-related issues.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Feature Toggles

Clauses.ClauseName: Processes for responsible use of AI systems

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable the UiPath Agents capability only where a documented process for responsible use is in place, including defined human oversight mechanisms, given the autonomous nature of agent-based AI systems.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Agents

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable Coded Agents in UiPath only for development personas with documented AI responsibilities, and shall require code review of agent logic before deployment as part of its processes for responsible use of AI systems.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Coded Agents

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Autopilot for Everyone
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable Autopilot in UiPath Assistant only after defining a process that ensures users understand the AI system's intended use, data handling implications, and limitations, consistent with the organization's responsible AI use framework.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Autopilot for everyone

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Studio/Studio Web Autopilot
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable Autopilot for Studio/Studio Web as part of a documented responsible use process that includes review of AI-generated code by qualified personnel before publication or deployment.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Studio and Studio Web features

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Apps AI Features
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable AI features in UiPath Apps only where a documented review process ensures that AI-generated application components meet the organization's security and responsible use standards before deployment.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Apps features

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Document Understanding AI
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable generative AI features in UiPath Document Understanding only where document types and data sensitivity have been assessed, and where data handling practices comply with the organization's responsible AI use processes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Document Understanding features

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable AI-powered UIAutomation features in UiPath only where application and URL guardrails are configured, ensuring that AI-driven UI interactions are constrained to approved systems as part of the organization's responsible use processes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable UIAutomation AI features

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable GenAI Activities in UiPath only where third-party LLM calls have been assessed for data residency and cost implications, and where usage is governed by the organization's processes for responsible use of AI systems.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable UiPath GenAI activities

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Communications Mining AI
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable external LLM access for Communications Mining only where the LLM provider has been assessed and approved under the organization's supplier management and responsible AI use processes, given that communications data may be sensitive.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable IXP

Controls.Description: The organization shall define a documented process governing the use of the UiPath AI Trust Layer master toggle, including criteria for disabling third-party AI model calls across the platform. This control is a primary mechanism for operationalizing the organization's processes for responsible use of AI systems.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable generative AI classification in UiPath Document Understanding only where document types and data sensitivity have been assessed and where data handling complies with the organization's responsible AI use processes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable generative AI extraction in UiPath Document Understanding only where the organization's responsible use process has assessed the document types, data sensitivity, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product toggles

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable GenAI Recovery Methods
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable AI-powered recovery methods in the UiPath Healing Agent only where the responsible use process includes monitoring of recovery outcomes and a defined escalation path when AI recovery produces unexpected results.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Healing Agent GenAI recovery methods

Controls.DisplayName: Product Toggles — Enable Healing Agent GenAI
Controls.Description: The organization shall enable GenAI-powered recovery in the UiPath Healing Agent only for non-critical processes initially, and shall define escalation and monitoring processes to govern autonomous AI recovery actions.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable Healing Agent GenAI recovery methods

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict the ability to run automation from outside personal workspaces to production-authorized personnel, ensuring that AI automation access is governed by the organization's responsible use processes.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Feature Toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall control the ability to share automation URLs in UiPath Assistant, ensuring that access to AI automation entry points is governed and does not bypass the organization's responsible use controls.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Feature Toggles

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable Autopilot in UiPath Studio Web as part of a documented responsible use process that includes human review of AI-generated development outputs before publication.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio Web > Feature Toggles

Clauses.ClauseName: Objectives for responsible use of AI system

Controls.Description: The organization shall enable output content filtering in UiPath agents to ensure that AI-generated responses meet the safety and compliance standards defined in the organization's objectives for responsible AI use before delivery to users.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Centralized Guardrails

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure the UiPath Healing Agent to generate fix recommendations for human review, in alignment with the objective of maintaining meaningful human oversight of AI-driven decisions that affect production automation.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Healing Agent

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict autonomous self-healing in UiPath to non-critical processes during initial deployment, in accordance with the objective of responsible AI use that balances automation efficiency with the need for human oversight of consequential AI actions.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Healing Agent

Clauses.ClauseName: Intended use of the AI system

Controls.Description: The organization shall govern the use of Picture-in-Picture mode in UiPath, ensuring that visibility into AI automation sessions is controlled and that sensitive data processed by AI automation is not inadvertently exposed.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Feature Toggles > Enable Picture-in-Picture

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure UiPath Workflow Analyzer activity restrictions (ST-USG-026) to block activities that fall outside the intended use of AI automation, preventing the use of high-risk or unauthorized automation capabilities. To configure: enable ST-USG-026 at Error and populate ProhibitedActivities and AllowedActivities.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > ST-USG-026

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure a runtime application allowlist in UiPath Automation Ops robot policies, ensuring that AI automation interacts only with applications within its documented intended use during execution. To configure: enable RT-UIA-001 at Error and add approved applications to whitelistApps.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Runtime Analyzer > RT-UIA-001

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure a runtime application blocklist in UiPath Automation Ops to prevent AI automation from interacting with sensitive or restricted applications (e.g. security tools, privileged consoles) that fall outside its intended use. To configure: enable RT-UIA-001 at Error and add restricted applications to blacklistApps.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Runtime Analyzer > RT-UIA-001

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure a runtime URL allowlist in UiPath Automation Ops robot policies, ensuring that AI-driven web automation accesses only approved domains within the documented intended use of the AI system. To configure: enable RT-UIA-001 at Error and add approved domains to whitelistUrls.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Runtime Analyzer > RT-UIA-001

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure a runtime URL blocklist in UiPath Automation Ops to prevent AI automation from accessing unauthorized or high-risk web destinations outside its documented intended use. To configure: enable RT-UIA-001 at Error and add high-risk destinations to blacklistUrls.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Runtime Analyzer > RT-UIA-001

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure application and URL restrictions for the UiPath Healing Agent to ensure that AI-driven recovery actions are constrained to systems within the documented intended use of the AI system. To configure: enable HA-UIA-001 and set allowedApps, forbiddenApps, allowedUrls and forbiddenUrls.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Healing Agent > HA-UIA-001

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure popup closure restrictions for the UiPath Healing Agent to prevent AI-driven dismissal of security dialogs, confirmation prompts, or other interactions that fall outside the agent's intended use. To configure: enable HA-UIA-002 and list the dialogs to block in forbiddenPopups.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Robot > Healing Agent > HA-UIA-002

Controls.DisplayName: Model Governance — Third-Party AI Providers Allowlist
Controls.Description: The organization shall maintain an approved list of third-party AI providers accessible through UiPath Integration Service, ensuring each provider is assessed under the supplier management process for compliance with the organization's responsible AI use requirements.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Models

Controls.Description: The organization shall assess and approve external LLM providers used by UiPath Communications Mining under its supplier management process, ensuring that AI model providers meet the organization's responsible use requirements before communication data is processed.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > AI Trust Layer > Product Toggles > Enable IXP

Controls.Description: The organization shall configure UiPath Workflow Analyzer package restrictions (ST-USG-014) to enforce an approved package allowlist, ensuring that only supplier-provided components that have been assessed and approved are used in AI automation. To configure: enable ST-USG-014 at Error and populate AllowedPackages and ProhibitedPackages.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Studio > Workflow Analyzer > Rules > ST-USG-014

Controls.Description: The organization shall restrict UiPath Assistant custom widgets to sources that have been assessed under its supplier management process, ensuring that third-party widget components meet the organization's responsible AI use standards.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Widgets > Allow custom widgets

Controls.Description: The organization shall prefer official UiPath widget feeds over custom sources, as official widgets are subject to the vendor's quality and security review process, providing greater assurance for the organization's AI management system.
Controls.ConfigLocation: Governance > Policy Library > Automation Ops > Assistant > Widgets > Use official feeds

UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall document a policy for the development or use of AI systems.
The organization shall determine where other policies can be affected by or apply to, the organization’s objectives with respect to AI systems.
The AI policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or additionally as needed to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness
Roles and responsibilities for AI shall be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization
The organization shall define and put in place a process to report concerns about the organization’s role with respect to an AI system throughout its life cycle.
The organization shall identify and document relevant resources required for the activities at given AI system life cycle stages and other AI-related activities relevant for the organization.
As part of resource identification, the organization shall document information about the data resources utilized for the AI system.
As part of resource identification, the organization shall document information about the tooling resources utilized for the AI system.

As part of resource identification, the organization shall document information about the human resources and their competences utilized for the development, deployment, operation, change management, maintenance, transfer and decommissioning, as well as verification and integration of the AI system.

The organization shall establish a process to assess the potential consequences for individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies that can result from the AI system throughout its life cycle.

UnsupportedClauses.ClauseName: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall document the results of AI system impact assessments and retain results for a defined period.

UnsupportedClauses.ClauseName: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall assess and document the potential societal impacts of their AI systems throughout the system’s life cycle.

UnsupportedClauses.ClauseName: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall identify and document objectives to guide the responsible development AI systems, and take those objectives into account and integrate measures to achieve them in the development life cycle.

UnsupportedClauses.ClauseName: Documentation of AI system design and development
UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall document the AI system design and development based on organizational objectives, documented requirements and specification criteria.
The organization shall determine and document details about the acquisition and selection of the data used in AI systems.

UnsupportedClauses.ClauseName: Quality of data for AI systems
UnsupportedClauses.Description: The organization shall define and document requirements for data quality and ensure that data used to develop and operate the AI system meet those requirements.
The organization shall define and document a process for recording the provenance of data used in its AI systems over the life cycles of the data and the AI system.
The organization shall define and document its criteria for selecting data preparations and the data preparation methods to be used.
The organization shall determine and document a plan for communicating incidents to users of the AI system.
The organization shall determine and document their obligations to reporting information about the AI system to interested parties.
The organization shall ensure that responsibilities within their AI system life cycle are allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.
The organization shall ensure that its responsible approach to the development and use of AI systems considers their customer expectations and needs.
